page.layout: One page of text, one column of dictionary entries in English, Latin and Hebrew. Running head centred at top. Page number at top right. Catchword alone at bottom right.

main_text.p: ter, Absque: בְּלִי Idem: בְּלִינָה Nihilum.
בְּלִיַּעַל Nequam, nullius frugis. vide & יעל.
בָּלָה Veterafcere, Inveterafcere, Teri, Deteri ex vetustate. Pihel בִּלָּה Trivit, Detrivit, Confumpsit. Chald. Fatur. יִבְלֵא Deteret, Daniel 7.25. cum א loco ה.
בָּלֶה m. Vetus, Tritum: plur. בְּלִים. Fœmin.
בָּלָה Inveterata, Effeta: plur. בְּלוֹת, Veteres, Trita.
בְּלֵהָה f. vide supra in בְּהֵל.
בְּלִי Chald. Tributum vetus: vel Tributum capitale sive capitationis, Esr.4.13.
בָּלַל Confundere, Miscere, Turbare. Hithpahel הִתְבּוֹלֵל Confundi, Commiscere se.
בָּלַם Claudere, Obturare, Constringere; בְּלִימוֹד vide supra in בַּל.
בָּלַם Inquisivit, Perquisivit. Sic Chald. בְּלֵשׁ.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel pointing is approximate, especially on the entries at the left edge, where the scan is dark. Some Hebrew forms in the lines beginning "בְּלִיַּעַל" and "יִבְלֵא" are uncertain and not checked letter by letter. The Latin "ter," at the top is a fragment from the previous entry. The Hebrew word at the bottom right is the catchword, not a heading. The page number is printed in small type and may read 42 or 43.
